## Codebase Summary: `code-agent-ui`

### 1. Project Structure

```
code-agent-ui/
├── src/
│   ├── main.tsx                    # App entry point + all route definitions
│   ├── config/
│   │   └── applicationMenu.tsx     # Navigation menu item definitions
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── layout/
│   │   │   ├── MainLayout.tsx      # Root shell with sidebar + content area
│   │   │   ├── SideBar.tsx         # Collapsible sidebar nav
│   │   │   └── PageHeader.tsx      # Reusable page title/subtitle/actions header
│   │   ├── navigation/menu/
│   │   │   └── Menu.tsx            # Menu renderer
│   │   └── VersionBadge.tsx
│   ├── pages/                      # One file per route page
│   │   ├── Dashboard.tsx, Jobs.tsx, JobDetail.tsx, NewJob.tsx
│   │   ├── RepoSettings.tsx, Hooks.tsx, Prompts.tsx
│   │   ├── Plans.tsx, PlanDetail.tsx, NewPlan.tsx
│   │   ├── QualityReports.tsx, ReviewMetrics.tsx, AiStats.tsx

│   │   ├── keycloak.ts             # Keycloak JS init/token management

│   │   └── version.ts

│       ├── base.css, tailwind.css, fonts.css
```

---

### 2. UI Framework / Component Library

**No component library (MUI, Ant Design, etc.) is used.** The project is entirely **custom-styled using Tailwind CSS v4** combined with a comprehensive **CSS custom property (design token) system**. All components are hand-built with:

- **Tailwind CSS v4** (`@tailwindcss/vite` plugin) for utility classes
- **CSS variables** as design tokens (e.g. `var(--color-cards-card-background)`, `var(--color-buttons-button-primary)`, `var(--border-radius-card)`) defined in `light.css` / `dark.css`
- **lucide-react** for all icons
- **framer-motion** for animations

---

### 3. Page Structure Patterns

All pages follow a very consistent pattern:

```tsx
export default function SomePage() {
  // 1. TanStack Query for data fetching
  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({ queryKey: [...], queryFn: () => api.get('...').then(r => r.data) })
  const mutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: ... })

  // 2. Local state for UI (filters, modals, selected items)
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null)

  // 3. JSX wrapped in <main>
  return (
    <main>
      <PageHeader title="..." subtitle="..." actions={...} />
      {/* page body using Tailwind + CSS vars */}
      {isLoading && <div className="skeleton-shimmer ..." />}
      {!isLoading && (...)}
    </main>
  )
}
```

Sub-components (modals, rows, cards) are defined in the **same file** as the page that uses them. No external UI component files are shared across pages (except `PageHeader`).

---

### 4. API Calls

All API calls go through a **single axios instance** at `src/lib/api.ts`:

- `baseURL` is `VITE_API_URL` (env variable)
- **Request interceptor**: calls `refreshToken()` then attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
- **Response interceptor**: on 401, calls `keycloak.login()` to redirect

Usage in pages:
```ts
import api from '@/lib/api'

// In useQuery:
api.get('/jobs').then(r => r.data)
api.get('/status/${jobId}').then(r => r.data)

// In useMutation:
api.post('/jobs/new', payload)
api.put(`/settings/${key}`, req)
api.delete(`/settings/${key}`)
api.patch(`/settings/memories/${id}`, { active: ... })
```

Data fetching is exclusively via **TanStack Query v5** (`useQuery`, `useMutation`, `useQueryClient`). Cache invalidation uses `qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...] })` after mutations.

---

### 5. Routing

Routing uses **TanStack Router v1** (file-free, code-first mode — all routes defined in `main.tsx`):

- A `rootRoute` wraps everything with auth initialization logic
- A `layoutRoute` (renders `MainLayout` with sidebar) is the parent for all protected routes
- An `accessDeniedRoute` is a sibling to `layoutRoute` (outside the layout)
- Parameterized routes use `path: '/jobs/$id'` and `jobDetailRoute.useParams()` to extract params

All routes:
```
/                   → Dashboard
/jobs               → Jobs
/jobs/new           → NewJob
/jobs/$id           → JobDetail
/plans              → Plans
/plans/new          → NewPlan
/plans/$id          → PlanDetail
/metrics/quality    → QualityReports
/metrics/reviews    → ReviewMetrics
/stats              → AiStats
/settings/repos     → RepoSettings
/settings/hooks     → Hooks
/settings/prompts   → Prompts
/settings/memories  → Memories
/settings/system    → SystemSettings
/access-denied      → AccessDenied
```

---

### 7. `src/main.tsx` and `src/config/applicationMenu.tsx`

**`main.tsx`**: Single file that serves as the app entry point, defines all routes, creates the QueryClient, and renders the app. The `RootComponent` handles auth initialization — it calls `checkAuth()` on mount, shows a spinner while Keycloak initializes, and redirects to `/access-denied` if not authenticated.

**`applicationMenu.tsx`**: Exports a `ApplicationMenuItems()` factory function that takes `navigate` and `currentPath` to produce the full menu tree. The menu has two-level items: top-level items (Dashboard, Jobs, Plans) and collapsible parent groups ("Metrics" and "Settings") with children. Uses lucide-react icons throughout.

---

### 8. `src/types/api.ts`

Defines all TypeScript interfaces for the API, organized into sections:
- **Jobs**: `JobStatus`, `JobType`, `JobStatusResponse`, `RunFixRequest`, `ReviewPrRequest`, `GenerateTestsRequest`
- **Repo Settings**: `RepoSettings`
- **Automation Hooks**: `AutomationHook`
- **Prompt Templates**: `PromptTemplate`
- **Execution Plans**: `PlanStatus`, `PlanStep`, `PlanPhase`, `ExecutionPlan`
- **Quality Reports**: `QualityReport`, `CoverageSection`, `LinterSection`
- **AI Stats**: `AiCallSummary`, `AiCallDailyStat`, `AiCallRecord`
- **Review Metrics**: `ReviewMetrics`
- **Memory**: `MemoryEntry`
- **Customer Registry**: `CustomerConfig`, `ProductConfig`, `GitConfig`, `JiraProjectConfig`, `ConfluenceProductConfig`, `AwsConfig`, `EnvironmentConfig`, `TeamMember` + upsert request types
- **System Settings**: `SystemSetting`, `UpsertSettingRequest`

---

### 9. `SystemSettings.tsx` Patterns

This is the most complex page and establishes some key patterns:
- **Static metadata catalog** (`SETTING_GROUPS`) declares all known settings with label, description, input type, defaults — the page merges this with live API data
- **Tabs + accordion groups** layout: 5 tabs, each containing multiple collapsible `SettingSection` accordions
- **Inline editing**: `EditableSettingRow` handles text/number/select/textarea/secret inputs with edit/save/cancel in-place (no modal)
- **Custom toggle pill** component for boolean settings
- **Toast notifications** implemented manually (no library) — auto-dismiss after 3.5s
- **Search** across all setting groups (bypasses tabs when active)
- **Skeleton shimmer** loading states via `skeleton-shimmer` CSS class

---

### 10. SSE / Streaming Implementations

**There are none.** No `EventSource`, `text/event-stream`, or streaming patterns exist anywhere in the codebase. Live updates for running jobs are achieved via **polling** using TanStack Query's `refetchInterval`:
- Job detail page polls every **5 seconds** while status is `RUNNING`, `PENDING`, or `QUEUED`
- Dashboard recent jobs polls every **15 seconds**
- Dashboard AI stats polls every **30 seconds**
